entries.he: מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ שׂוֹנְאִים יַכְנִיעַ אֶת עַצְמוֹ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה יַצִּילֵהוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מִשּׂוֹנְאָיו.
entries.en: 17. Someone who has enemies should humble himself, and through this G-d will save him from his enemies.

entries.en: 19. When a person has enemies and he does not think of how to take revenge against them, but remains bound to the joy of the Blessed G-d, through this the Holy Blessed One gives him the power to avenge himself against them.
entries.he: כְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם אוֹיְבִים, וְאֵינוֹ חוֹשֵׁב אֵיךְ לִנְקֹם בָּהֶם אֶלָּא, הוּא דָּבוּק בְּשִׂמְחַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא נוֹתֵן לּוֹ כֹּחַ לִנְקֹם מֵהֶם.

entries.en: 24. Sometimes, the Holy One, Blessed be He, hardens the heart of the wicked in contention against the righteous in order that [the wicked] have a downfall.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Contention, Part 1, item 24
images.description: In a sunlit courtyard, an elder gestures as two bearded men listen. Nearby, one boy pours water from a can while two others press soil around a young tree.

images.description: בחצר שטופת שמש, איש מבוגר מדבר בתנועות ידיים ושני גברים מזוקנים מקשיבים לו. בקרבתם ילד משקה עץ צעיר במשפך ושני ילדים מהדקים את האדמה סביבו.

entries.en: 25. One who gives honor to an elderly man is saved from war.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Contention, Part 1, item 25

entries.en: 26. One who recounts his quarrel before the Holy One, Blessed be He, sees his vengeance on his enemies.
